name: Shower Niches Done Right: Placement, Size, and Waterproofing
title-tag: Shower Niche Placement, Size & Waterproofing | Everett WA
meta-description: Shower niche guide from a tile installer: shelf height of 48-60 inches, sizes that fit stud bays, prefab vs built, and why the niche is where DIY showers leak.
post-summary: September 22, 2026 · A shower niche is three decisions: placement you can reach, a size your framing agrees with, and waterproofing that treats the niche as part of the membrane system — because the niche is where DIY showers actually start leaking. Here is where to put it, what sizes fit a stud bay, and the honest prefab-vs-site-built comparison.
